Notice
The Walk in Interviews for appointing Guest Faculty to teach at Panjab University Constituent
College, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga) for the Academic Session 2026-27 for the following subject
will be held in the Selection Committee Room (First Floor) of Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan,
Panjab University, Chandigarh as per the following schedule:
Date Subject No. of Vacancies Time
15.10.2026 Physical Education 1 3.00 PM
The applicants are required to fill the application form for Assistant Professors available on
Panjab University Website (http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php pages 1 to 9).The candidates
should bring all their original certificates and other relevant documents along with duly
filled application form with the attested copies of all the certificates/ documents (Two
Copies of each document) and two passport size photographs.
 The salary and qualification for the post will be as per Panjab University,
Chandigarh/ Pb. Govt. Norms.
 The Candidates will have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistant from any agency till they are teaching in
Panjab University Constituent College, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga) as a Guest Faculty.
 No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
Sd/-
